scientific_integrity: Reproducibility checker uses Python standard-library exact rational arithmetic; its finite evaluations corroborate an unrestricted analytic argument and are not substituted for it. Public-source comparisons were made at the statement/implication level.
scientific_limitations: Finite real total orders and strictly positive observation/edge weights; quadratic regression only. The unweighted-observation contraction criterion follows from an earlier NUNA theorem; originality is claimed for the exact arbitrary-mass modulus, attained chord law, and concave-majorant computation. No independent audit has occurred.
title: Sharp mass-aware concavity law for variation stability of weighted isotonic regression
